title: events
description: Every id with bound state, and what was bound. One entry per state change plus the ids the scan was told to include. A state hash repeats when nothing changed, so a consumer can group without re-reading the state files.

pso.description: the pipeline state object's resource id

shaders.description: `vs=2348 ps=2349`, stages in a fixed order

targets.description: `<id> <w>x<h>x<d> <FORMAT>`, the output-merge state at this id

depth.description: the depth target's resource id, `0` for none

state.description: hash of what the state file was written from

scanStopped.description: why the sweep stopped, empty when it reached the end
